The House of Habsburg ( / ˈ h æ p s b ɜːr ɡ / ; German : Haus Habsburg , lit. ' House of the Hawk 's hill ' [haʊs ˈhaːbsbʊrɡ] ⓘ ), also known as the House of Austria , [ note 6 ] was one of the most powerful dynasties in the history of Europe and European influenced polities. They were best known for ruling vast realms throughout Europe and the Americas during the Middle Ages and early modern period , including the Holy Roman Empire and Spain . [ 3 ] [ 4 ]
